items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Big God and Jefferson. [INTERVIEWEE] Mm-hmm. Big God and Jefferson. That's all I think I'm in the one.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, that's right too. They're very, very bad instruments too. You've got to control them with their lips and the fingers. They're so small, you know what I mean? Half the finger knows the horn like this. And then you get on that. It's equivalent to a clarinet. I mean a close finger. Well, it's much easier to play it than a clarinet, of course. A clarinet is very bad on it. A clarinet is one instrument that if you start playing it, you better stay on it. Because after you once get off it, hmm, it's bad. You…
Let's see, we were talking about your favorite dramas too. That's the only thing you named two of them. Yes, brother. Big God and Jefferson. Big God and Jefferson.
Mm-hmm. Big God and Jefferson. That's all I think I'm in the one.
